decision_rule.ADMITTED: the CI95 lower bound of the paired official pooled SLU-F1 delta (CELL-1 minus PLAN) is ABOVE ZERO and the CI95 lower bound of the paired intent delta exceeds -0.9943 (owner decision 99, the TRAIN lock: a gain is proven, not merely non-inferior)
decision_rule.DELTA_CONSUMPTION: item S3-4s: the per-node delta-consumption table -- how many deltas each node was supplied per row, which value_ids were supplied, and the saves and harms on the rows that received each one -- is a PRIMARY deliverable, reported whatever the verdict, and is what decides which deltas survive into store version 2.
decision_rule.FRONTIER: owner decision 75: the frontier row (official SLU-F1 delta x prefilled tokens per row x GPU hours per 1,080 rows) is reported on every verdict and placed beside the registered rows.
decision_rule.HARMFUL: a MEASURED loss on either guard (owner decision 25, Method B: a CI95 upper bound below zero, or a point estimate beyond the margin); width alone is NEUTRAL, never HARMFUL
decision_rule.NEUTRAL: both guards are non-inferior -- the SLU CI95 lower bound exceeds -1.2485 and the intent CI95 lower bound exceeds -0.9943 -- without a proven SLU gain
decision_rule.PER_SCENARIO_HARM_BOUND: owner decision 17: per-scenario intent and SLU tables over all 18 scenarios in BOTH the natural-mixture and the equal-stratum weighting, with net harmed rows per scenario and any scenario of five or more flagged. A breach is a diagnostic beside the verdict, never a gate.
decision_rule.REPLICATION: an ADMITTED result is replicated on the SAME roster before any DEV, Fold B or test read (the owner iteration rule; no DEV read is authorised by this package).
decision_rule.TWIN: ATTRIBUTION, never admission. The twin arm is read with the same estimator against the same sealed PLAN comparator. A gain the twin reproduces within the plan's own null is FORM (the store's shape and token volume), not content, and the verdict says so and claims no content effect. A gain the twin does not reproduce is attributed to the deltas' content, with the twin delta reported beside it.
decision_rule.comparator: the sealed PLAN arm SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DEFAULT-PLAN-LOCK-V1 (official 63.6304 / 82.2222); nothing is re-flown
decision_rule.efficiency_is_reported_regardless: every efficiency deliverable is reported whatever the verdict

planner_action_illegal. The flight's own count, the sample ids that carry it, and their action character counts and SHA-256 values (the form inherited from the B7a recovery note's section 8). This is the failure item E8c repaired; it is reported whether or not it is zero.

FIRST-REQUEST BYTE IDENTITY, stated honestly before contact. Under this arm the first request of a row (Perception) is NOT byte-identical to the base's: the slot-contract cards it carries are the v2 release's (M4b). What IS claimed and what the smoke proves: no request carries a tools array; the delivered answer of every row passed the normaliser node (one receipt per row); the Reviewer and Planner requests differ from the base's only through the upstream content.

NATIVE TASK-CONTRACT CALL COUNT against the anchor's realized 1,082, and the count of tool calls emitted by a role that holds no authority (expected zero; a non-zero count is not a failure of the flight -- the rail refuses the call and the episode continues -- but it is the single most interesting behavioural consequence of showing three more roles the tool definitions, and it is reported per role).

PER-SCENARIO intent and SLU tables over all 18 scenarios, in BOTH the natural-mixture and the equal-scenario weighting, plus net harmed rows per scenario with any scenario of five or more flagged (owner decision 17) -- a diagnostic the verdict must carry, not an additional gate.

resume_recovery_clause: owner decision 22 of 2026-09-18. If an attempt dies of an INFRASTRUCTURE failure with code and request bytes unchanged -- never a harness or config defect -- the one allowed recovery may be a RESUME-RECOVERY under item E10 instead of a re-fly: every complete row of the aborted attempt is kept without selection, every partial or unstarted row is flown under the same run id, and the merged manifest declares the predecessor attempt with its trace hash, kept-row list and that list's hash. It changes no question, roster, factor, comparator, decision rule or cap, and the run-cumulative budget must be re-checked because a resumed attempt and its predecessor share one run id. A resumed EFFICIENCY read must additionally state the split of its GPU hours and prefilled tokens across attempts, because a merged manifest's cost is the sum of two lease windows and a per-row rate computed over the merged manifest alone would be wrong.

smoke_acceptance.compaction: THE SECOND ITEM THIS SMOKE EXISTS FOR: the E20 compaction receipts, per phase. The registered worst-case bound puts the SOLVER phase at COMPACT_REQUIRED by 317 tokens (prompt_fit above), so the smoke reports how many of its four rows actually compacted, at which phase and by how much, beside cell PLAN's own sealed zero. A non-zero count is a cost and a caveat on the frontier row's token basis, not a failure; an abstention caused by compaction IS a failure and stops the arm.

supply_reach.twin_fixed_points: 16 of 379 twin rows landed on a facet set equal to their own, against 0 under v1. That is arithmetic, not a defect: v1r's vocabulary is 39 distinct intents over 379 rows, so a positional derangement sometimes hands a row an equal attachment, and the builder refuses only a twin that moved nothing at all. The twin is a genuine form control on 363 of 379 rows (95.8 %) and the verdict says so rather than claiming a perfect derangement.
supply_reach.twin_token_matching: The builder holds authored_token_count(twin) == authored_token_count(parent) (5,740), the node distribution exactly (119 / 151 / 95 / 14) and -- new at v1r -- the per-row facet-count multiset, because both derangements move a row's whole attachment as one unit. The v1 caveat that arm and twin could be REACHED at different volumes (arm solver 11 against twin solver 22) is gone: both are 379 of 379. The smoke still measures the per-node supplied item COUNTS on the same four rows and the verdict still reports the realised supplied-token delta rather than assuming it is zero.
supply_reach.what_it_means: Every value of the released store is reachable on every node, arm and twin. The route is therefore NOT inert and the B9a-rec failure mode (18 ACQUIRE rows, 0 items each) is excluded before contact. This is still an UPPER BOUND, not a prediction: a given row supplies only the deltas attached to the at most three intents its own Perception step proposed, capped at 8 / 4 / 4. The smoke's delta-supply acceptance measures the REALISED per-node counts on four rows and a route that serves zero items on every row still stops the arm.
supply_reach.what_this_is: A MODEL-FREE upper bound on what each candidate-bound route can ever select, computed by intersecting each value's associated_facet_ids with the 60 registered SLURP candidate intents of prepared/SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-CANDIDATE-CONTRACTS-PREPARE-V1/catalog.json. A candidate-bound route matches a value only when one of its facet ids EQUALS one of the row's Perception candidate intent ids. Measured by scripts/flights/batch/adv1_to_deltas_steps.py reach and written into the release-pins document coordination/slurp-stage3-delta-cell-r01-v1/stage3-deltas-v1r-release-pins.json.
